snippet.title: Stonefall - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
🪨 Stonefall's demo is live on Steam! 🪨

You are a stone, fallen from the cosmic abyss into an unforgiving dark fantasy world. Unleash abilities as you jump, roll, slam and air-cannon your way through deadly obstacles, topple four colossal bosses in souls-like combat, and return to the cold void of space where you belong.

🪨 Play the demo now: https://midnighte.rs/stonefall-steam

This trailer was a part of ✨Midnight Screening 2026✨ a showcase of new games, demo drops and trailers! Check out the full lineup here: https://youtu.be/FFpPlTp4eyo

See the full Midnighters lineup on our website: http://www.midnighters.games
